in_sanskrit.name: हस्मुख
in_sanskrit.meaning: हस्सनाद (शस्त्र वाद्य वादक) [स्मित प्रकाशित वाक्य का शब्द]
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one whose speech is full of joy, wisdom, and eloquence. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'has-mukha', meaning 'smiling face' or 'joyful speech'. It is also associated with the use of weapons and musical instruments in Hindu mythology.

in_hindi.name: हस्मुख
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one whose speech is joyful and ever-changing.

in_tamil.name: ஹாச்முக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who brings joy and happiness to the hearts of others.

in_telugu.name: హ౱స్ముఖ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The god of joy and happiness. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'has-mukha', meaning 'smiling face' or 'joyful speech'. It is also associated with the god of joy and happiness in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Hasmukh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hasmukh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who speaks sweet and pleasant words, or one who is always cheerful and content.

in_bengali.name: Hasmukh
in_bengali.long_meaning: Hasmukh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who speaks sweet and pleasant words, or one who is always cheerful and content.
